gl:definition.gl:content: entity owned by or under the custodial duties of an organization, which has either a perceived or actual value to the organization

gl:notes.gl:content: An asset can be single entity, a collection of entities, an assembly of entities or a composition of entities.

gl:examples.gl:content: Examples for physical entities are equipment, raw material, parts components and pieces, supplies, consumables, physical products, and waste.
Software is an example of a digital asset.
A software license is an example of an intangible asset.

gl:ref.gl:source: IDTA-01001-3.2:2026 (Specification of the Asset Administration Shell — Part 1: Metamodel)
